The report is person-level by statute, so a record here says only that the one person listed under this title is paid this figure as of that date - never that the post pays it to whoever holds it. Titles carried by more than one person are refused, because two salaries under one title make the figure undecidable. Rows reading $0.00 are refused: ten of them are uncompensated appointees, and an uncompensated arrangement is a fact about a person, not about the post. The report's NAME column is discarded at parse time and appears nowhere in this file. Matching is scoped to descendants of 'exec-eop-who'; a title being unique in the graph is not evidence of placement. Basic pay is not the node's cost. Regenerate by re-running the script; never edit by hand.
